description: ARM SQL server with no auditing and public network access on
note: CIS Azure 5.1.1 and 5.1.7. A SQL server with no auditing and public network access left on: no record of who reached it, and the whole internet able to try. Relabelled 2026-09-23 when KICS replaced Trivy on ARM and Bicep: Trivy's ARM adapter could not satisfy four of its own checks (docs/trivy-azure-arm-adapter-gap.md), so the trivy:AZU-* labels here are gone and the KICS query that covers the same control takes their place.
